about: Every outside source The Way uses or has considered, with what it may be used for. Reviewed 2026-10-12. 'status': in use / not added (and why).

resources.provider: AO Lab Free Use Bible API (bible.helloao.org)
resources.type: Bible text (JSON), chapter audio and verse timings
resources.licence: Free to use; BSB text public domain
resources.attribution: Passages load from the Free Use Bible API (bible.helloao.org)
resources.offline: Chapters the reader opens or saves are kept in the browser cache
resources.notes: Replies are checked: used only if they are BSB and contain verses.

resources.type: Bible text, saved in the site (data/bsb)
resources.notes: Fallback only. Provenance and checksums in data/bsb/manifest.json. Footnotes omitted; text verified verse by verse against the release.

resources.type: Old Testament sources named in BSB footnotes (js/otrefs.js)
resources.attribution: Footnote sources: Berean Standard Bible (public domain)

resources.provider: OpenBible.com recordings via the Free Use Bible API
resources.licence: As published by the API; check before storing offline
resources.attribution: Audio via the Free Use Bible API; narrator named in the player
resources.notes: Plays only when the reader presses play.

resources.provider: Tyndale Open Study Notes (via the Free Use Bible API)
resources.offline: Saved with the Gospels when the reader chooses
resources.notes: Shown only in the Study notes tab, apart from Scripture.
The download could not be reached from the build environment. The BSB's own footnotes are used instead. Votes would not show fulfilment or certainty.

resources.provider: Faith Comes By Hearing, Bible Brain
resources.notes: Needs an approved key, and a check of which recordings and translations may be used and stored.
Phase 2: a few chosen videos, loaded only on tap, with credit.
Needs keys, quotas and caching terms checked. Never shown as BSB.
